description: What a buyer gets after paying for this product: files, links and license keys. Written under $app.digital_downloads.

deliverables.label: Deliverable
deliverables.description: Files and links a buyer can open after paying. Each keeps its id when its file or URL changes, so past buyers always get the current version.

source.description: link: an external URL. bucket: a file uploaded to the store's own S3-compatible bucket

url.description: Destination of a link deliverable. Must start with https://

rules.error: Add the https:// link buyers should get

object_key.description: Key of the uploaded file in the bucket

filename.description: File name the buyer's download is saved as

size.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes

variant_id.description: The only variant that includes this deliverable. Empty means every variant

version.description: Optional version label shown to buyers, e.g. 2.1

download_limit.description: Downloads allowed per deliverable for each purchase. Empty uses the app setting

access_days.description: Days after purchase that downloads stay available. Empty uses the app setting

license_enabled.description: Give each buyer a license key

license_source.description: generate: create a random key per purchase. pool: hand out keys you imported, and stop sales when none are left

license_pattern.description: Shape of generated keys. Each X becomes a random letter or digit

license_activation_limit.description: Devices or sites a key can be activated on. Empty means unlimited

date_keys_low_notified.description: When admins were last warned that this product's key pool is low

license_valid_days.description: Days a key stays valid after purchase. Empty means it never expires
